prompt: Create a saved comparison of viable cell density between CHO-007-R01 and CHO-007-R02 and summarize the numerical result. Use exact matching elapsed sample times and define differences as CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01. Report the mean signed difference, largest absolute difference, its elapsed time in hours, and name both batches. Include the deliveries still in review and state their provisional status.

output.content:
**Result (CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01, viable cell density):** across 14 exactly matched sample times (0 to 193 h elapsed), the mean signed difference is **−26,452 cells/mL** (R01 higher on average), and the largest absolute difference is **696,666 cells/mL at 169.0 h elapsed** — CHO-007-R02 at 6,783,333 cells/mL versus CHO-007-R01 at 6,086,667 cells/mL. Peaks were similar in timing: CHO-007-R01 reached 11,400,000 cells/mL and CHO-007-R02 11,066,667 cells/mL, both at 138 h. The comparison is saved in the workspace as a completed comparison task (14/14 samples matched exactly, no unmatched times).

These values are **provisional — still in review**: they were read from the delivery files and not yet reviewed, and the delivery carries 79 open checks (mostly missing fields, plus a duplicate conflict and layout changes), so verify the delivery before relying on them. The comparison used the Northfield Biologics **November runs** delivery, one of three deliveries currently in review:

- Northfield Biologics · November runs (CHO-007-R01/R02, CHO-008-R01/R02, CHO-009-R01/R02) — provisional
- Northfield Biologics · October runs (CHO-004-R01/R02, CHO-005-R01/R02, CHO-006-R01/R02) — provisional
- Harborview CDMO · fed-batch runs (CHO-010-R01/R02, CHO-011-R01/R02, CHO-012-R01/R02) — provisional

Caveats from the saved result: this is a descriptive comparison only (successive samples of one run are not independent, so no significance test is reported), and product, process version, equipment, scale and process stage are not recorded for these batches, so any difference between runs cannot be attributed to conditions.
